title: Agent: read a live sortie's model thinking rows on NERV-01 (read-only)
goal: Confirm on NERV-01, read-only, that a real sortie after the update shows the consultant and Misato rows with model and seconds
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update reaches F-129-T02, the newest sortie with a misato.consult round, read through the same data the sortie view renders (read-only, no chat sent), lists the consultant and Misato rows with their model and seconds, adding up to about the sortie's duration; the agent pastes the rows and the sortie id (no message text) into F-129
privacy: Neutral invented sorties and model names only.
validation: Agent-run read-only check on NERV-01, recorded in F-129 Verification
escalation: Nothing is written to ~/.nerv, ~/.nerv-app or the live service; a row that reads wrong goes back to F-129-T02

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one chat request and a look at its sortie. Not a measurement. 2026-11-26: converted from an owner check to an agent read-only check (owner-step triage): the rows and seconds are data, any sortie after the update shows them.
